text:
emma_sales: Hi team — customer (FinBank) wants an on‑prem airgapped POC next month. They need a minimal image (no telemetry), HSM pinning (FIPS), and a 6‑week upgrade window. Any blockers on packaging + pricing impact?

raj_se: Got it. Quick q — do they require signed deltas or full re-image each update?

emma_sales: Prefer deltas (sneakernet). They also asked for offline license activation tied to HSM.

olivia_eng: Deltas feasible but we currently only ship chunked minibundles. We can produce delta minibundles but it needs ~2+ weeks ops lead to wire up the signing pipeline and SBOM. Quantized model variants add complexity (may force full bundle).

raj_se: Inventory checklist we need: SBOM, manifest, chain-of-trust signing cert, release notes, and offline activation token flow. We'll need the customer's HSM vendor + model info.

mike_security: Clarify HSM pinning: do they want us to use their HSM to sign builds, or do they want to re-sign artifacts on their side? Two supported paths: 1) we provide Redwood-signed artifact and customer re-signs with their HSM (recommended) or 2) we integrate with their HSM during final signing (hard offline ops + legal). Option 1 has least risk.

emma_sales: They prefer we provide signed artifact + an activation token they import to their HSM. Also asked for explicit telemetry opt-out and no call-home.

alice_ops: Telemetry opt-out is supported for Private/on‑prem bundles — we build a zero-telemetry artifact. That increases build and QA time, and slightly bumps bundle size since we include extra diagnostic assets. Requires build flag: `--no-telemetry`.

olivia_eng: Note on deltas: delta updates require strict version pinning and KV cache compatibility. If the model quantization/profile changes between versions we will need a full reimage. We'll detect and flag incompatibility at build time.

raj_se: Pricing roughs: sealed on‑prem POC with HSM pinning + signed minibundles = one-time packaging engineering fee + optional retainer for ongoing signed delta builds. Ballpark: $25k packaging + $5k/month retainer + per-major-update engineering on top. I'll formalize.

emma_sales: Can someone write a short preflight checklist I can share with customer (network, certs, HSM, timeline)?

olivia_eng: Yep — quick checklist to share:
- Provide firewall egress rules for initial artifact transfer (list attached)
- HSM vendor + model + cert export (public fingerprint)
- Offline signer public cert we ship for verification
- Target GPU profile / model quantization expectations
- Allowed maintenance windows (max 6 weeks cadence requested)
- Storage/transport plan for minibundle (USB / local repo)
- Checksum & verification procedure (sha256 + signature)

Also sample manifest we expect in the bundle:

```
manifest:
  bundle_version: "1.0.4"
  signed_by: "redwood-signer-v2"
  hsm_anchor: "<customer-hsm-cert-fingerprint>"
  sbom: "sbom-1.0.4.json"
  delta_from: "1.0.3"
```

raj_se: I'll draft a pricing bullet + SOW items: packaging scope, signing handoff, retainer terms, and acceptance tests.

mike_security: I'll own the security questionnaire answers (key handling, attestations, retention). Quick answers: we do NOT store customer private keys; we recommend customer re-signing. We can retain verification hashes and provide attestations for each signed artifact.

emma_sales: Perfect — need to reply to customer by EOD tomorrow with checklist + rough pricing.

deploy-bot: build-pipeline: job `minibundle-sign` queued for `poc/FinBank` — estimate completion 2024-05-14 18:30 UTC.

olivia_eng: Timeline estimate: packaging PR -> 5 business days onboarding -> 10 business days to produce signed minibundle + SBOM + docs -> 3 business days internal test -> handoff. Total ~4 weeks (could be 6 if quant rework needed).

emma_sales: Great — I'll send this to FinBank and ask for HSM cert + allowed maintenance windows. Thanks :thumbsup: 

raj_se: FYI I'll add a caveat about quantized models possibly forcing full-image updates.

mike_security: Also flagged: legal will need to confirm liability around signing chain if we do joint signing.

emma_sales: Noted — will loop legal if customer insists on us integrating with their HSM.
